title: Generation of mouse models carrying B cell restricted single or multiplexed loss-of-function mutations through CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing
protocol: Seed 1.8–2.0 × 10^6 HEK293T cells per 10 cm² plate in 10 mL DMEM + 10% FBS.
Add cells dropwise and gently swirl to mix evenly.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ until the following afternoon until ∼60%–70% confluence.
Set up 2 sterile 1.5 mL tubes per plate in a biosafety cabinet.
Prepare a mixture of transfection plasmids (psPAX2, VSV-G envelope, pLKO5 vector) and add OPTI-MEM to reach a total volume of 225 μL.
Dilute TransIT-LT1 transfection reagent with OPTI-MEM in another tube.
Mix the diluted TransIT-LT1 by swirling the tip or gently flicking the tube without pipetting or vortexing.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°–25°C).
Add the diluted TransIT-LT1 mix to the 3 plasmid mix dropwise.
Mix by swirling the tip or gently flicking the tube.
Incubate the transfection mix for 30 min at room temperature (20°–25°C).
Carefully add the transfection mix dropwise to the plate of HEK293T cells.
Be careful not to dislodge cells.
Move cells to lentivirus room BSL2 incubator.
Incubate for 18 h or until the following morning (37°C, 5% CO2).
Remove starting media using a 10 mL serological pipet.
Add 10 mL of virus harvest media very slowly against side of plate to reduce dislodging of cells.
Incubate cells 24 h in lentivirus room (37°C, 5% CO2).
Carefully remove virus-containing media from the plate using a 10 mL syringe.
Attach a 0.45 μm filter to syringe and filter into a 50 mL tube.
Do not fill over 40 mL per Falcon tube; keep on ice or at 4°C.
Add 10 mL of virus harvest media very slowly against side of plate to reduce dislodging of cells using a 10 mL serological pipet.
Incubate cells 24 h in lentivirus room (37°C, 5% CO2).
Store virus harvest at 4°C overnight (12–16 h) in cold room.
Repeat viral harvest with syringe and filter.
Pool harvested virus as desired, keeping tube volume under 40 mL.
Add a 1:3 dilution of Lenti-X Concentrator to the pooled virus.
Mix by inverting the solution 10 times.
Incubate at 4°C for 2–4 hours.
Spin the mixture in a refrigerated centrifuge at 1,500 × g for 45 minutes.
Decant and discard the supernatant into a container with 100 mL bleach to inactivate any residual viral particles.
Resuspend the pellet(s) in 50–100 μL single-use aliquots.
Store viral preparations at −80°C until use.
Euthanize donor mouse according to approved methods.
Collect spine and complete lower limbs from the donor mouse.
Remove all muscle tissue from bones.
Smash spine, femur, tibia, and fibula with a mortar and pestle in RPMI + 10% FBS media.
Use approximately 40 mL of media for four rounds of smashing (10 mL each round).
Filter media through a 40-μm filter placed on a Falcon 50 tube.
Cut spine into pieces once in the mortar to smash more effectively.
Use pestle to prevent any pieces from falling into the filter when decanting off.
Count cells in a standard cell counting chamber before proceeding with hematopoietic progenitor enrichment.
Spin down at 400 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend in FACS buffer using 1 mL of buffer per 100 million cells.
Enrich hematopoietic progenitors using EasySep Mouse Hematopoietic Progenitor Cell Isolation Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Pour enriched cell suspension into a 50 mL collection tube while holding and pouring from magnet with one hand.
Collect excess cell suspension at the tip of the flow tube using a P1000 tip.
Count cells after EasySep isolation.
Spin down cells at 400 g for 5 minutes at 4°C after EasySep isolation.
Resuspend cells in sterile FACS buffer using approximately 1 mL of buffer per 20 × 10^6 cells.
Gently remove supernatant using a P1000 tip to prevent cell loss.
Block Fc receptors by incubating cells with 1 μL purified anti-CD16/32 (diluted 1:100) per 1 million cells on ice for 10 minutes.
Stain cells with appropriate antibodies and incubate on ice in the dark for 15 minutes.
Wash stained cells by adding approximately 10 mL of FACS buffer and spinning down at high speed to minimize cell loss.
Discard supernatant using a P1000 tip.
Resuspend cells in FACS buffer using approximately 1 mL per 20 × 10^6 cells.
Filter the resuspended cells through a 40-μm filter cap polystyrene 5 mL FACS tube immediately before sorting.
Sort Lineage- cells that are Sca-1+ and c-Kit+ into StemSpan media supplemented with murine cytokines thrombopoietin (TPO) and stem cell factor (SCF) at a concentration of 50 ng/mL.
Gently resuspend sorted cells in a 50 mL Falcon tube at 20,000 LSKs/mL in pre-warmed media (StemSpan with 50 ng/μL TPO and 50 ng/μL SCF) and gently invert tube for homogenous resuspension.
Plate cells according to downstream application (48-well plate for titration vs. 6-well plate for in vivo transplantation) at 20,000 LSKs/mL.
Add 1 mL per well in a 48-well plate or maximum 5 mL per well in a 6-well plate.
Incubate plate for 20–30 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
First add polybrene 1 μL/mL (concentration = 10 μg/μL stock aliquots) then 10 μL virus added dropwise.
Resuspend gently using a P1000.
Spin for 2 h at 900 g at 37°C.
Remove plate and incubate plate at 37°C overnight (12–16 h).
Change LSK media after overnight (12–16 h) incubation: spin plate for 5 min at 400 g and exchange media extremely gently.
Be careful when moving plate from incubator to hood to avoid dislodging cells.
Incubate plate at 37°C for 72 h post-transduction.
Assess mCherry positivity by flow cytometric analysis.
Pre-condition 8-12 week old CD45.1 recipient mice with 800 rads split dose irradiation (2 doses of 400 rads each), one day prior to injection.
If recipient strain is NSG, pre-condition with 250 rads split dose (2 doses of 125 rads each).
Isolate hematopoietic stem and progenitors from the bone marrow of a separate donor mouse.
Spin plate containing transduced LSKs at 400 g for 5 min at room temperature (20°–25°C) to allow cell adhesion to bottom of plate.
Open plate adapter very gently inside lentiviral hood to avoid cells returning in suspension.
Thoroughly collect all cells and wash with PBS containing 20% FBS (PBS- 20% FBS) and transfer to 15 mL Falcon tubes.
Spin for 5 min at 400 g at room temperature (20°–25°C).
Add 1 ml PBS- 20% FBS to well.
Gently collect by pipetting 3–4 × against the side and bottom of well to wash cells off the surface.
Collect cells into a 15 mL tube.
Repeat one wash with 5 mL PBS.
Spin tubes at 400 g for 5 min at room temperature (20°–25°C).
Remove supernatant with P1000 until about 1 mL remains.
Use P200 to remove supernatant until ∼100–150 μL remains.
Resuspend samples in a total of 600–650 μL PBS per cells for every 5 mice.
Split sample into 1 eppendorf per cage with 600–650 μL resuspended cells.
Inject 100 μL cells into the tail vein of recipient mice.
Draw 200 μL peripheral blood from the submandibular vein.
Incubate blood with 1 mL Ammonium-Chloride-Potassium (ACK) lysis buffer for 5 min.
Wash cells with FACS buffer.
Stain cells with 100 μg each of specific antibodies.
Sort edited (GFP+mCherry+) B cells according to sorting strategy.
Design primers for multiplexed PCR, targeting a 200bp region flanking the sgRNA cut site.
Isolate DNA from sorted cells via the QIAamp DNA Microkit.
Amplify 5–10 ng of isolated DNA by multiplexed PCR.
Purify PCR product using a DNA purification kit.
Submit purified PCR product for targeted sequencing (10–35 ng/μL concentration).
Process FASTQ files by CRISPResso2 software analysis to assess gene edits quantitatively and qualitatively in individual samples.
